user.title: Add a Siemens S7-1200/1500 controller
user.description: Connects over S7CommPlus (port 102). PUT/GET does not need to be enabled. If the controller refuses, TLS and the connection role are tried automatically.

data_description.connection_type: HMI suits most controllers. Try 'Engineering station' if the controller refuses.
data_description.password: Only if the controller has access protection with a password.

tls.name: TLS (secure communication)
tls.description: On by default: S7-1200 firmware V4.5+ and S7-1500 V2.9+ only accept TLS. Certificates are optional: leave the paths empty and the controller certificate is not checked. To verify it, give its CA file, e.g. /config/s7/ca.pem.

error.connection_reset: The controller dropped the connection ({error}). TLS and both connection roles were tried.
